name: Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah
charge: Prophesying lies in the Lord's name to the captives; committing adultery with their neighbours' wives
summary: Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah prophesied lies among the captives and committed adultery with their neighbors' wives. The Lord named their sins and announced that Nebuchadnezzar would kill them and that their names would become a curse among the exiles.
offense: Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah prophesied lies in the Lord's name among the captives in Babylon. They also committed adultery with their neighbors' wives. God joined their public religious falsehood with the private wickedness they might have thought concealed. These were the two named prophets among the exiles, not the kings who bore the same names. The Lord declared that He knew and was a witness. Neither distance from Jerusalem nor the conditions of captivity put their conduct beyond His sight.
judgment: The Lord announced that He would deliver them into Nebuchadnezzar's hand and that the king would kill them before the captives' eyes. Their names would become a curse among the exiles, recalling the two whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire. Jeremiah's letter records the announced punishment. Their position as speakers to the captive community made the lie no less accountable. God's people were to reject false promises and heed the word He had actually sent concerning their life in exile and His appointed time of return.
offenseFull: Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah prophesied lies in the Lord's name among the captives in Babylon. They also committed adultery with their neighbors' wives. These were the two named prophets among the exiles, not the kings who bore the same names. The Lord declared that He knew and was a witness. Neither distance from Jerusalem nor the conditions of captivity put their conduct beyond His sight.

entries.commentary: Jeremiah sent a letter from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders, the priests, the prophets, and all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried captive to Babylon, after Jeconiah, the queen, the eunuchs, the princes, the carpenters, and the smiths had departed. Just like in this captivity, our people still carried those talents and skills; we had carpenters and we had blacksmiths.

The Most High tells the captives that even in their captivity they should build houses and dwell in them, buy homes, plant gardens and eat the fruit of them. They are to take wives and beget sons and daughters, take wives for their sons and husbands for their daughters, that they may be increased and not diminished, and seek the peace of the city where He caused them to be carried away, for in the peace thereof they shall have peace. -

Let not the false prophets and diviners in the midst of the people deceive them, nor their dreams; today Christianity has so-called prophets and Islam has so-called prophecy, but they deceive people because that is not the right way to serve the right God. After seventy years are accomplished at Babylon the Most High will visit them and perform His good word to return them, for His thoughts toward them are of peace and not of evil, to give them an expected end; the same is happening today, knowledge is being increased, we are finding out who we are and coming back to God's laws to be saved out of this captivity. When they call upon Him, seek Him, and search for Him with all their heart, He will be found of them and turn away their captivity, gathering them from all the nations and places whither He drove them; this is why the leadership goes out and teaches in the four corners of the earth, because all our people have been driven to the four corners.

Because they said the Lord had raised them up prophets in Babylon, the Most High declares He will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence upon them and make them like vile figs that cannot be eaten, and deliver them to be a curse, an astonishment, a hissing, and a reproach among all the nations. This is because they had not hearkened to His words, which He sent by His servants the prophets, rising up early; so it behooves us to follow God's laws, for the prophets today are the ones going out teaching on the corners every Sabbath and seven days a week. The Most High never comes down here Himself to speak to the people; He speaks through His servants the prophets. -

Concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesied a lie in His name, the Most High would deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar to be slain before the captives' eyes. They would become a curse, the Lord make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire, because they committed villainy in Israel, committed adultery with their brothers' wives, and spoke lying words in His name. -

To Shemaiah the Nehelamite: because he sent letters in his own name to all the people at Jerusalem and to Zephaniah the priest, claiming the Lord had made Zephaniah priest in the stead of Jehoiada to put every man that makes himself a prophet in prison and the stocks, and asking why he had not reproved Jeremiah for telling the captives their captivity was long and to build houses. Zephaniah read the letter in the ears of Jeremiah, and the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, for the Lord was dealing with Jeremiah, that was the difference. Because Shemaiah prophesied when the Lord sent him not and caused the people to trust in a lie, the Most High would punish him and his seed; he shall not have a man to dwell among the people nor behold the good the Lord will do, because he taught rebellion against the Lord.

Woe is pronounced on the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of the Most High's pasture and have not visited them, so He will visit upon them the evil of their doings. He will gather the remnant of His flock out of the countries where He drove them, bring them again to their folds, and set up shepherds who will feed them so they fear no more and none are lacking.

The Most High promises to raise unto David a righteous Branch, a King who shall reign, prosper, and execute judgment and justice, in whose days Judah shall be saved and Israel dwell safely. His name is called THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS; this is plainly referring to Christ. The day comes when they will no longer swear by the Most High who brought Israel out of Egypt, but by Him who led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country and all the countries where He had driven them, back to their own land.

Jeremiah's heart is broken and his bones shake like a drunken man because of the prophets and the words of the Most High's holiness, for the land is full of adulterers and mourns under swearing. Both prophet and priest are profane, and the Most High has found their wickedness even in His house, so their way shall be as slippery ways in the darkness where they are driven and fall. The prophets of Samaria prophesied in Baal and caused Israel to err, and the prophets of Jerusalem commit adultery, walk in lies, and strengthen the hands of evildoers so that none return from wickedness, becoming as Sodom and Gomorrah before Him.

The people are told not to hearken to the prophets who make them vain and speak a vision of their own heart, not out of the mouth of the Most High, telling those who despise Him that they shall have peace and no evil shall come. This is like the pastor who says, let me tell you what God told me to tell you, when it is a lie. None of these prophets has stood in the counsel of the Most High; had they stood there and caused the people to hear His words, they would have turned them from their evil way, but instead the whirlwind of His anger will fall grievously upon the head of the wicked in the latter days.

The Most High asks whether He is a God only near and not far off, when He fills heaven and earth and no one can hide in secret places where He cannot see him. He has heard the prophets who prophesy lies in His name saying, I have dreamed, thinking to cause His people to forget His name by their dreams as their fathers forgot it for Baal. Let the prophet with a dream tell a dream, but let him that has His word speak it faithfully, for His word is like a fire and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces; He is against those who steal His words and use their own tongues to lie on the Most High.

When the people, prophet, or priest ask what is the burden of the Most High, Jeremiah is to answer, What burden? for He will forsake them, and every man who claims the burden of the Most High He will punish in his house. Instead of saying the burden of the Most High, they are to ask one another what the Most High has answered and spoken, for they have perverted the words of the living God. Because they keep saying the burden of the Most High after being told not to, He will utterly forget them, forsake them, and cast them out of His presence with an everlasting reproach and perpetual shame that shall not be forgotten. --- Topics: [Idolatry](/encyclopedia/idolatry) · [The Covenant](/encyclopedia/the-covenant) · [The Priesthood](/encyclopedia/the-priesthood)

The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel; they shall eat the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and his inheritance. Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the Lord is their inheritance, as he hath said unto them.

This shall be the priest's due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether ox or sheep: they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw. The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him. For the Most High hath chosen him out of all thy tribes to stand to minister in the name of the Lord, him and his sons for ever.

If a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the Lord shall choose, then he shall minister in the name of the Lord his God, as all his brethren the Levites do which stand there before the Lord. They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.

When thou art come into the land, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations: there shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch, or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer. These things actually existed and they are all real: wizards, necromancers, divination, observers of times, people that consult with familiar spirits. If they were not real, they would not be in the Bible with the Most High telling us not to do them. All that do these things are an abomination unto the Lord, and because of these abominations the Most High driveth those nations out from before thee. Thou shalt be perfect with the Lord thy God, meaning upright; the nations hearken unto observers of times and unto diviners, but as for thee, the Most High hath not suffered thee so to do.

The Lord thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken. This is talking about Christ, Yeshua. This answers what Israel desired of the Most High in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the Lord my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not; and the Lord said, They have well spoken that which they have spoken. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him; and whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him. If we do not follow Christ and do what Christ says, that judgment falls on us.

The prophet which shall presume to speak a word in the name of the Most High which he hath not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die. By this law a lot of these pastors stand condemned: they say things and claim Christ said them, when the Most High never commanded Christ to say it and Christ is not telling them to say it. How shall we know the word which the Lord hath not spoken? When a prophet speaketh in the name of the Lord, if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that is the thing which the Lord hath not spoken; the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously, and thou shalt not be afraid of him. --- Topics: [Clean and Unclean Meats](/encyclopedia/clean-and-unclean-meats) · [Esau and Edom](/encyclopedia/esau-and-edom) · [Idolatry](/encyclopedia/idolatry) · [Sacrifice and Atonement](/encyclopedia/sacrifice-and-atonement) · [The Covenant](/encyclopedia/the-covenant) · [The Feasts of the Most High](/encyclopedia/the-feasts-of-the-most-high) · [The Priesthood](/encyclopedia/the-priesthood) · [The Sabbath](/encyclopedia/the-sabbath)

Whosoever of Israel or of the strangers in the land gave of his seed unto Molech was surely put to death; the people of the land stoned him with stones. This is the child sacrifice shown in [Ezekiel 16](/bible/ezekiel/16), slaying the children of the Most High and delivering them to pass through the fire. If the people of the land hid their eyes from the man and killed him not, the Most High set His face against that man and against his family. When you see wickedness you must utter it and expose it; a witness that holds his peace bears iniquity. Sin brings judgment on a whole house. Achan coveted the goodly Babylonish garment, the silver, and the wedge of gold, and he and his sons and his daughters and all that he had were stoned and burned in the valley of Achor. What you do is not just about you; your sin can bring judgment on your family.

The soul that turns after such as have familiar spirits and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, is cut off from among his people. Sanctify yourselves and be ye holy; keep the statutes of the Most High, for He is the Lord which sanctifieth you. Every one that curseth his father or his mother shall surely be put to death; his blood shall be upon him. Disrespecting your mother and your father carried the death penalty.

The man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress, shall surely be put to death. This world openly defends adultery and men even boast of committing it with another man's wife; the scriptures call for death upon both.

The man that lies with his father's wife, and the man that lies with his daughter in law, shall surely be put to death; they have wrought confusion. If a man lie with mankind as he lieth with a woman, both have committed an abomination and shall surely be put to death; abomination means hateful and disgusting unto the Most High. The man that takes a wife and her mother is burnt with fire, both he and they, that there be no wickedness among you. The man or woman that lies with a beast is put to death, and the beast is slain also. All of these judgments fall under the laws of adultery, the sub-statutes of that commandment.

The man that takes his sister and sees her nakedness, it is a wicked thing; they are cut off in the sight of their people, and he bears his iniquity. The man that lies with a woman having her sickness, her menstrual cycle, has discovered her fountain, and both are cut off from among their people; this goes with the laws of [Leviticus 15](/bible/leviticus/15). The nakedness of the mother's sister and the father's sister is near kin; they bear their iniquity. He that lies with his uncle's wife or takes his brother's wife, they shall die childless.

Keep all my statutes and all my judgments, that the land whither I bring you spew you not out. Walk not in the manners of the nation cast out before you, for they committed all these things and therefore the Most High abhorred them. I am the Lord your God, which have separated you from other people. The Most High separated Israel from the other people, so Israel is to walk differently; these laws are the separation.

Put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean; this goes back to [Leviticus 11](/bible/leviticus/11), the dietary laws. No shrimp, crab, lobster, pork, catfish, and the like; everything is not clean, whatever the church teaches. If you eat whatever you please, you are not separating yourself from the other nations. Ye shall be holy unto me, for I the Lord am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

A man or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, was surely put to death by stoning. The tarot card readings, the fortune telling, and the horoscopes of today are that same dealing with familiar spirits; do not touch any of it.

verses.text: Hear ye therefore the word of the Lord, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:

Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon, saying, The Lord make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;

Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours’ wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the Lord.
For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the Lord.

I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.
And the man that committeth adultery with another man’s wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
